villageSocial.diagnosis: Through the shared HUD routing a fresh greeting does not cause flight and the journal action advances the story. One attack set Ilyan to hostility 2500 (flight threshold 2000) with no decay over 3000 ticks; he fled from every approach. The first diagnostic test only reached him because he was cornered at the map edge.
villageSocial.honestRedNote: The strengthened acceptance assertions were written after the diagnosis and were not executed as a formal RED before the fix; the diagnostic logs are the reproduction.
villageSocial.core: CoreVerification ALL PASS 19676 assertions (26 new calm/camp assertions incl. save/load replay of the next calming step)

revisionNote: Native runs executed on the working tree whose tracked files equal the committed fixes, except that Unity had generated a compact NpcForgeCalm.cs.meta; the committed meta adds the full MonoImporter block with the same GUID. Static preflight 40/40 and the Unity/Android contract pass on the committed files.

findings: Returning a stolen ration to an already full camp completed the side task with Mara's gratitude bonus
Greeting spam (1 s cooldown) reconciled a frightened villager within about 13 s instead of gradually
changes: Side task requires a net contribution: own donations (plus a paid replace decision) must exceed own thefts; saves that already refilled the camp with real donations are credited once
Greeting reconciles at most once per 300 ticks (30 s); help still reconciles because it spends real provisions
reviewFixes.red: Both new Core assertions failed against the pre-review revision ce402ec (calm-greeting-spam-reconciles-once-per-interval, camp-returning-stolen-ration-is-not-the-side-task)
reviewFixes.untested: The one-time credit for pre-feature saves (camp already refilled before the side task existed) has no dedicated test; it cannot be constructed through the public API.

prReview.comment: Codex P2: a camp refilled before the memory archive existed could never complete the side task
prReview.change: Completion now uses Mara's persisted legacy memory, present in every save: every handed-over ration counts as help, every camp theft, robbery or assault as a hostile act; completion needs a full camp and more helps than hostile acts. Pre-archive refills are credited on the first village tick after migration.
